# tools

smart-base's Tool nodes: DAK-shaped capabilities such as DMN to FHIR Questionnaire. A Tool node is a declaration (what it consumes, what it produces, which skill it satisfies), not a copy of upstream Python; execution stays upstream until it moves too. Capabilities that are not DAK-shaped, such as the two Library strippers, belong to `fhir-harness` by `smart-stack-layering`.

Part of [SMART Base](../README.md) 0.1.0, declared as `tools`, holding `tools`.
